channel.title: RVA Burlesque
channel.description: Burlesque shows in Richmond, VA. Confirmed dates only; tentative [TBD] dates are kept out of the feed until firmed up.

item.title: Under The Veil: A Night Of Burlesque & Variety Entertainment
item.description:
When: Tuesday, June 30, 2026 · 9pm

Where: The Veil Brewing-Scott's Addition, 1509B Belleville St, Richmond, VA 23230

In-the-round burlesque and variety show by Burlesque Right Meow at Veil Brewing. Doors open at 8:30pm, show starts at 9pm; tickets available at the door.

item.title: Villain Era: A Burlesque Tribute to Bad Witches And Bitches
item.description:
When: Friday, July 3, 2026 · 7:30pm – 10pm

Where: Firehouse Theatre, 1609 West Broad Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Cost: $20

Villain Era returns to Firehouse Theatre with a new lineup of captivating criminals, wicked witches, power-hungry queens, and iconic antagonists in a night of seductive, theatrical burlesque. Doors at 7:30pm, show at 8pm; $20 advance / $25 day of / $30 VIP. 18+ only.

item.title: BRAS: A Burlesque and Variety Tribute to The Fast and The Furious
item.description:
When: Saturday, July 11, 2026 · 7pm – 9pm

Where: Ember Music Hall, 309 East Broad Street West, Richmond, VA 23219

A turbocharged burlesque and variety show celebrating The Fast and the Furious franchise, where performers strip down faster than a quarter-mile run and transform iconic characters and ridiculous plot twists into a sexy, hilarious spectacle. 21+ only.

item.description:
